name: Claim by Ouroboros
description: Stores a brand's approved claims, current offers, proof, voice, and banned phrases so an AI assistant reads the guide before it writes. A check rejects draft copy that invents a guarantee or discount, uses a banned phrase, or states an offer that is not active. Tools: list_brands, create_brand, get_brand_guide, save_approved_claim, save_offer, save_proof, save_brand_voice, save_banned_phrase, remove_banned_phrase, check_brand_copy. Hosted remote endpoint with OAuth and Dynamic Client Registration; requires an account. Docs: https://ouroborosapps.com/docs/claim. Published in the Official MCP Registry as io.github.LAHutchins91/claim. Made by Ouroboros Apps (https://ouroborosapps.com).
author: Ouroboros
